description: Student data schema for junior high schools (SMP/MTs): 61 fields in 5 groups (identity, family, address, interests and health, aid and documents) with types, validation, conditional rules, edit units and 17 option lists. A schema only: it contains no personal data.
status: ready (reference schema; apps adapt it with the school and record their changes)
source: Written by Arumi Studios (2026-11-25); skema-siswa.txt is the source, skema-siswa.json is generated by tools/converters/skema-siswa.py
related: Region fields use data set wilayah (+ kodepos when ready); origin school uses data set sekolah; option lists will be mapped to official Dapodik codes when referensi-dapodik is ready (R-07). Handling rules for this much personal data: docs/school-data.md.
